systems.country_label: Surveillance Outbreak Response Management and Analysis System (SORMAS)
systems.owner: Institut National d'Hygiène Publique (INHP), under the EU-funded CORESMA project
systems.tiers: pilot in 2 regions (Abidjan and Gbêkê) and 11 districts, July-August 2021 to June 2023; fully electronic

note: The study describes DHIS2, MAGPI and SORMAS only as outbreak and infectious disease surveillance tools (class single-function); it says nothing of DHIS2's routine reporting of patients treated, so no HMIS fact is taken, and it names no EMR.
